surface: Quest completion progression, the Quest card completion orbit, and curated automatic ladders
scope: Build one persistent universal Quest mastery system across goal domains, repair the 16/5 overflow, automatically advance only curated non-custom ladders at five honest completions, and express accumulated practice through the existing Quest completion orbit and reward receipt without adding a second progress authority or pressure mechanic.
user_job: See that repeating any worthwhile Quest is becoming a real accumulated practice, and trust that a starter Quest promising to rise will actually update without requiring a separate night ritual.

active_sources.judged_state: The owner's school, apartment, fitness, creative, and Walk 10 minutes examples translated into one universal mastery contract and safe curated auto-rise boundary.
The existing open jeweler's orbit, warm closed completion, aged brass structure, single luminous action, static resting ornament, and never-punish contract remain authoritative.
active_sources.viewport: Quest board across supported phone states

superseded_sources.reason: Night Flow remains historical context but no longer owns curated default Quest rises; requiring a separate close-out allowed Walk 10 minutes to remain at 16/5 indefinitely.

product.decision: Every committed recurring Quest completion advances permanent mastery equally, while prescription difficulty changes only for curated non-custom Quests with an authored ladder.
product.proof: School, apartment, fitness, creative, and generic fixtures at the same completion count resolve to the same mastery tier; only the curated walking ladder changes its visible prescription.

interaction.decision: The fifth curated completion atomically records mastery, advances one ladder rung, resets bounded rung progress, and names the earned change once inside the existing completion receipt; undo and restore reverse or preserve the whole result together.
interaction.proof: Engine, persistence, undo, legacy 16/5, final-rung, timer, journal, workout, all-day, and rapid completion tests observe the exact saved state.

visual.decision: Mastery enriches the existing static jeweler's orbit through earned brass geometry at 5, 15, 40, and 100 completions without increasing card height, adding a second chip, or creating autonomous spectacle.
visual.proof: Fresh phone renders compare unranked, kept, practiced, gilded, and masterwork orbits in featured and compact rows, including Reduced Motion and 1.3x text.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Clamp the displayed 16/5 to 5/5 without changing state
anti_fallbacks.why: It would hide the broken promise while leaving the visible prescription and persistence unchanged.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Use one fitness-specific ladder system as the progression answer
anti_fallbacks.why: Cleaning, school, care, creative, and generic goals would remain structurally less supported.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Automatically make every repeated custom or maintenance Quest harder
anti_fallbacks.why: It would turn recognition into pressure and can be unsafe or inappropriate for care and already-difficult work.

anti_fallbacks.fallback: Add a neon full-card competitive rank frame or another persistent progress chip
anti_fallbacks.why: It would crowd the daily board, copy the surface rather than the accumulation mechanism, and compete with the one luminous action.

first_real_slice.scenario: A person completes the default Walk 10 minutes for the fifth time, later restores legacy 16/5 data, and compares the resulting mastery with equally repeated study, apartment, and creative Quests.
first_real_slice.real_inputs: Production Quest models with a curated walking ladder, non-ladder recurring Quests from multiple domains, legacy persisted overflow, and the live Quest card and reward receipt.
first_real_slice.user_action: Complete the Quest, observe the receipt and updated card, leave and restore the save, then review other repeated Quests on the same board.
first_real_slice.expected_outcome: Walk advances exactly one safe rung and never shows an overflow; every Quest displays the same earned mastery tier for the same completion history; no non-ladder task silently becomes harder.
first_real_slice.state_boundary: Mastery count, rung, bounded rise progress, and tier crossing persist and revert atomically with the completion snapshot.

required_states.state: Walk 10 minutes at four current-rung completions and four lifetime completions
required_states.why_can_disprove: The pre-threshold state can reveal a premature tier or prescription change.
The key promise fails if the title, receipt, count, or saved rung diverges.

required_states.state: A restored authored walking Quest with risingStreak 16 and no mastery field
required_states.why_can_disprove: A cosmetic clamp, multi-rung punishment, or lost completion history can all look superficially fixed.

required_states.state: Study, apartment, fitness, creative, and generic Quests at 15 lifetime completions
required_states.why_can_disprove: Domain-specific branches or extra fitness chrome would make equal counts feel unequally valued.

required_states.state: A curated Quest on its final authored rung
required_states.why_can_disprove: An impossible rise prompt or 5/5 overflow would preserve the original architecture defect.

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Quest model, GameState roll, workout launcher, and undo snapshot
ripple_map.state: Ordinary, timer, journal, all-day, workout, rapid, undo, and restored completion
ripple_map.expected_effect: One committed real Quest completion changes mastery exactly once and keeps rise state atomic.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Focused model/engine/widget tests and persistence round trips.

ripple_map.surface_or_primitive: Featured and compact Quest completion orbit
ripple_map.expected_effect: Tier richness is visible through static geometry without extra row height or competing copy.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Fresh 430x932 contact sheet plus 320x568 and 1.3x text inspection.

ripple_map.state: Ordinary completion, mastery threshold, auto-rise threshold, and Reduced Motion
ripple_map.expected_effect: Only a newly earned tier or prescription adds one factual receipt line; ordinary completions keep existing density.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Widget behavior and rendered fifth-completion receipt.

ripple_map.state: Automatic curated ladder, manual custom ladder, and capped ladder
ripple_map.expected_effect: Automatic and capped Quests do not create a redundant or impossible RISE prompt; explicit custom rises remain optional.
ripple_map.verification_plan: Routine widget tests and direct state inspection.

unverified_property: A correct counter and green tests do not prove that universal mastery feels equally valuable across domains or that the progressively richer orbit remains legible rather than noisy on a real phone.

decisive_check.method: Run the production completion and persistence journey, then inspect a same-viewport cross-domain mastery board and threshold receipt at phone size.
decisive_check.target: Walk fifth completion, legacy 16/5 restore, five 15-completion domains, final ladder rung, 430x932, 320x568, 1.3x text, and Reduced Motion.
decisive_check.pass_condition: No state displays beyond 4/5, Walk changes exactly one rung when earned, all equal-count Quests share the same mastery geometry and semantics, non-ladder tasks do not become harder, and the board's existing hierarchy remains intact.
